title: Knight Rider
description:
S1 E11 — The Final Verdict
A former girlfriend (Penny Peyser) needs Michael's help when she is accused of murdering her boss.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E11 — Musical Mania
Gage's musical efforts irritate Station 51; rescue calls range from frostbite to a man trapped beneath his sliding canyon-home.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E12 — Helpful
An exhausted and emotionally upset woman doctor disappears from the hospital; Gage tries to help DeSoto with a marital difficulty.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E13 — Drivers
An all-star college quarterback collapses suddenly; Gage wants to discipline motorists who fail to yield to fire department vehicles.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E14 — School Days
The paramedics try to boost the confidence of a trainee who has doubts about his readiness to take on emergency duties in the field.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E15 — The Professor
Brackett cares for an ailing foreign dignitary; the paramedics rescue a helicopter pilot, deliver a baby and prevent a suicide jump.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E16 — Syndrome
Gage diagnoses tonsillitis for DeSoto, who claims to have had his tonsils removed; McCall is reunited with an old love (Robert Alda).

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E17 — Honest
Gage's and DeSoto's stands on honesty are put to the test when people who withhold vital information experience different consequences.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E18 — Seance
A woman believes her dead sister is the cause of accidents in her home; a man is trapped underwater in his car with the doors jammed.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E19 — Boot
Station 51's mascot, Boot, won't eat; accidents befall a woman attempting to cook a meal; a man nearly dies from an aspirin overdose.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E20 — Rip-Off
The paramedics conduct several rescues under a shadow of guilt after being accused of stealing from a patient; guest Jo Anne Worley.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E21 — Audit
DeSoto must decide whether to amputate the leg of a trapped construction worker (James McEachin); nervous Gage faces an IRS tax audit.

title: The A-Team
description:
S3 E5 — Timber!
The team helps brother-and-sister lumberjacks thwart a crooked union boss intent on driving them out of business.
